Endfield Shaking Breast Manager
USER GUIDE
========================

This guide describes the basic operation of the Secondary Motion Manager.

The Manager has four main pages:

    1. Main
    2. Characters
    3. Presets
    4. Developer

Most users only need Main, Characters, and Presets.
Developer is intended mainly for maintainers who add support for new characters.


============================================================
1. QUICK START
============================================================

Basic use:

1. Install/extract the package according to the release instructions.
2. Start the Manager. - select Game folder Eg. E:\......\Hypergryph Launcher\games\Endfield Game
3. Start Arknights: Endfield.
   The Manager and the game may be started in either order.
4. Wait until the Manager shows that the game/plugin is available.
5. Enter the game and switch to a supported character.
6. Open the Main page.
7. Enable the character if necessary.
8. Select a motion mode:

       Original
       Synthetic
       Amplify Native

9. For Synthetic mode, adjust Walk / Run / Sprint/zipline values as desired.
**Smoothing can affects the behaviours of Animation Transits eg, from run to stop **
10. Press Apply. The changes will be reflected without restart of game. 
11. Return to the game and test the result.
12. Repeat the adjustment if necessary.

The Manager is an external tool. No in-game UI is required.


------------------------------------------------------------
THE THREE MOTION MODES
------------------------------------------------------------

Original
    No custom secondary-motion transform is written for the selected character.

    Use this to return the character to the game's original
    animation/secondary-motion behavior.


Synthetic --- USE THIS -----
    Generates configurable secondary motion based on the
    character's current locomotion state.

    Walk, Run, and Sprint can use different amplitudes and
    frequencies.


Amplify Native ----NOT LOOKING GOOD for most characters ----
    Amplifies motion already produced by the game instead of
    generating the Synthetic gait oscillator.

    Use the Native Amplify value/factor to control the strength.


============================================================
2. MAIN PAGE
============================================================

The Main page is the quickest way to see the current runtime
state and adjust the actively controlled character.

Typical status fields include:

Game
    Shows whether the game is currently detected.

Plugin
    Shows whether the injected runtime/plugin is available.

Character
    Shows the currently detected controlled character.

Preset
    Shows the currently selected preset.


------------------------------------------------------------
CHARACTER ENABLE
------------------------------------------------------------

Enable
    Enables custom processing for the current character/profile.

When disabled, the character should use the original game behavior.


------------------------------------------------------------
MODE
------------------------------------------------------------

Choose one of:

    Original
    Synthetic
    Amplify Native


------------------------------------------------------------
GAIT SETTINGS
------------------------------------------------------------

Synthetic mode can use separate values for:

    Walk
    Run
    Sprint
    Zipline

Each gait normally has:

Amplitude
    Controls the rotational strength of the generated motion.

Frequency
    Controls how quickly the generated oscillation cycles.

Higher amplitude = larger movement.
Higher frequency = faster movement. NO NEED TO TOUCH it as I already adjuested according to Animations Frequencies. 


------------------------------------------------------------
ADVANCED SETTINGS
------------------------------------------------------------

Amplitude Scale
    Character-level multiplier applied to generated amplitude.

    The same raw angle can look different on different character
    rigs/models, so this can be character-specific.


Axis
    Selects the rotation axis used by the profile.

    Typical options:
        X - no character using this yet
        Y
        Z

    Normal users generally should not change a verified
    character's axis.


Direction
    Selects the positive/negative rotation direction.

    Typical options:
        +
        -

**Smoothing can affects the behaviours of Animation Transits eg, from run to stop **

Transition Smoothing
    Controls how smoothly amplitude responds when character switches between run/walk/sprint

    Larger value:
        slower / smoother transition

    Smaller value:
        faster / more responsive transition


Frequency Smoothing
    Controls how smoothly when applying smoothing
    Larger value:
        frequency changes more gradually

    Smaller value:
        frequency reacts more quickly


Stop Smoothing
    Controls the dedicated return-to-stop from run/walk/sprint
    Larger value:
        motion stops more slowly

    Smaller value:
        motion settles more quickly


Note: example usage of smoothing:
Frequency = 1, Stop = 0.5, the transition bounce will bounce less , smaller amplitude and stops, looks heavier.
Whereas for frequency = 0.5 and stop = 1 the transition bounce will jiggle more frequently before stops.

Native Amplify
    Amplification factor used by Amplify Native mode.

    This is separate from Synthetic amplitude.


Jump
    The legacy jump/landing feature may still appear in some
    development UI/builds.

    It is currently outside the main supported feature set and
    should normally remain disabled.


------------------------------------------------------------
APPLY
------------------------------------------------------------

Press Apply after changing values.

A successful apply should produce a visible success/acknowledged
state in the Manager.

If Apply reports an error, do not assume that the game accepted
the new values.


============================================================
3. CHARACTERS PAGE
============================================================

The Characters page is used to edit settings for a specific
supported character rather than only the currently controlled one.

The page normally contains:

    Character list
    Enable
    Motion mode
    Walk settings
    Run settings
    Sprint settings
    Advanced settings
    Apply


------------------------------------------------------------
CHARACTER LIST
------------------------------------------------------------

Select a character from the list to edit that character's
profile/preset override.

The selected character does not necessarily have to be the
character currently controlled in-game.


------------------------------------------------------------
PER-CHARACTER SETTINGS
------------------------------------------------------------

Each supported character can have independent values.

This is intentional.

Different rigs and models can produce different visual motion
from the same numeric angle, so one global setting is not assumed
to be correct for every character.


------------------------------------------------------------
DELETE FROM PRESET
------------------------------------------------------------

If the current UI contains "Delete from preset":

    This removes the selected character's user override from
    the database, as you need to re-scan the character


============================================================
4. PRESETS PAGE
============================================================

Presets store user-facing motion preferences.

The default character database contains technical character
information such as bone mappings and axis data; presets are
intended to store user choices such as mode and motion values.

Expected preset operations include:

Select
    Load/select a preset for editing/use.

New
    Create a new preset.

Duplicate
    Copy an existing preset.

Rename
    Rename a preset.

Import
    Import a preset file.

Export
    Export the selected preset for backup/sharing.

Delete
    Delete a user preset.

Reset
    Restore/reset values according to the current implementation.


------------------------------------------------------------
PRESET SHARING
------------------------------------------------------------

A shared preset should represent user motion preferences.

Technical character compatibility data should come from the
shipped character database rather than requiring every user
preset to redefine bone names.


============================================================
5. DEVELOPER PAGE
============================================================
============================================================
ADDING A NEW CHARACTER
============================================================

IMPORTANT:
    This section is for maintainers/developers.

    Do not add a character to the default database until the bone
    pair, axis, direction, and basic motion behavior have been
    verified in-game.


------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1 — DETECT THE CHARACTER
------------------------------------------------------------

1. Enter the game.
2. Switch to the unsupported/new character.
3. Open Developer.
4. Check the detected/canonical character ID.

Expected canonical IDs look similar to:

    chr_xxxx_name

It is an internal name for the company so dont be surprised if you see an unfamiliar name

Runtime suffixes such as Clone/object-instance text should not
become part of the canonical ID.


------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 2 — SCAN THE SKELETON
------------------------------------------------------------

Run the skeleton/bone scanner.
May wait for a few seconds, or can press 'scan' again. 
It will displayes all bones found, use filter to get the bones we need, generally 'breast' or 'xiong'
U will found a similar structure of xiong_R_0_skin_jnt or  breast_R_01_jnt you may found multiple ones

------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 3 — SELECT LEFT / RIGHT BONES
------------------------------------------------------------

Common bone-name families discovered during research include:

    breast_R_01_jnt / breast_L_01_jnt
    R_breast_01_jnt / L_breast_01_jnt
    xiong_R_0_skin_jnt / xiong_L_0_skin_jnt


for 'xiong' select R_0 instead of R_1
for 'breast' select R_1 instead of R_2


These are examples only.

Do not assume that an unknown character must use one of these
pairs without verifying it.

Select left and right bones with the buttons below


------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 4 — SAVE / PUBLISH THE CHARACTER
------------------------------------------------------------

You can enter the displayed name of the data, 
If not it will be displayed as chr_xxxx_name. You can always edit it in Character page
SAVE it. MUST Save before use it

------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 6 — VALIDATE
------------------------------------------------------------
Press Validate to see if everthing needed is here. Generally, I used the tool to import all characters, no mistakes found. 

A complete validation should confirm at least:

    Character ID valid
    Right bone found
    Left bone found
    Bones are distinct
    Axis valid
    Direction/sign valid
    Scale valid
    Gait amplitudes valid
    Gait frequencies valid
    Runtime write works
    No runtime error during the test

============================================================
7. BASIC TROUBLESHOOTING
============================================================

Game says Not Running
    Make sure the game is actually running.
    The Manager should not require the game to be started first.


Plugin is not Ready
    Check that the runtime DLL is installed in the expected
    package/plugin location.

    Check the runtime log if available.


Character is detected but motion does not run
    Confirm:
        - character is supported
        - character is enabled
        - mode is not Original
        - profile/bones are found
        - Apply completed successfully


Changing values has no effect
    Press Apply and verify that the Manager reports the new
    configuration as applied.

    Editing a field alone should not be assumed to update the game.
    
    Try with a larger value eg, 100 to see if it works


Motion looks wrong on only one character
    Use that character's per-character settings.

    Do not automatically change global values for every character.


Unsupported/new character
    Leave the character on native/original behavior unless you are
    intentionally profiling it through Developer Mode.


============================================================
8. PARAMETER REFERENCE
============================================================

Amplitude
    Motion strength / rotation size.

Frequency
    Oscillation speed in Hz.

Amplitude Scale
    Character-level multiplier.

Axis
    X / Y / Z rotation axis.

Direction
    Positive or negative axis direction.

Env Attack Tau
    Amplitude response smoothing.

Env Freq Tau
    Frequency response smoothing.

Env To-Idle Tau
    Stop/return-to-idle smoothing.

Native Amplify
    Amplification factor for Amplify Native mode.


============================================================
9. IMPORTANT NOTES
============================================================

- Settings are character-dependent.
- Unsupported characters should remain native rather than using
  guessed bone settings.
- The main supported visual target is the actively controlled
  character.
- Background party-member motion is not a product requirement.
- Jump-specific custom motion is currently not part of the main
  supported feature set.
- Game updates may require a plugin/runtime compatibility update.
- Keep the entire release folder together unless release
  instructions explicitly say otherwise.

============================================================
10. Uninstallation Steps
============================================================
1. Exit the Game
2. Delete the \Secondary Motion folder under Endfield's root (where you select when first launch the exe).
3. Delete the \plugin folder under Endfield's root. IMPORTANT: Make sure you delete 'plugin' folder with sbm.dll inside, NOT the 'plugins' with a 'S' behind - thats games's original folder, DONT TOUCH IT. 
4. Under Endfield's root folder, find d3dcompiler_47.dll and vulkan-1.dll, Delete and rename the d3dcompiler_47.dll.bak and vulkan-1.dll.bak back to normal (remove .bak), they are the original dll. OR delete them all , by right the game will use windows' own dlls which not recommanded. 
5. Delete the Whole manager folder, the one you unzipped. 
6. Game is clean now.
